item.title: Peso Pluma & Kenia Os Break Up, Say Split Ends ‘With Love, Respect and On the Best Terms’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update. We've got some news to share with you about two of Mexico's biggest young music stars. Peso Pluma and Kenia Os have announced that they've ended their relationship.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "The couple shared a joint statement on Instagram Stories on Saturday, confirming the breakup. They expressed their gratitude for the love they've received and asked fans to respect their decision and privacy during this personal moment.
[Music transitions to a brief clip of "Tommy & Pamela"]
Host: "You might remember that Peso Pluma and Kenia Os first collaborated on the song 'Tommy & Pamela' back in 2024. The reggaetón-leaning track was a hit, debuting at number 40 on Billboard's Hot Latin Songs chart and later peaking at number 20.
[Music returns to the soft background tune]
Host: "The breakup marks the end of a high-profile relationship between two talented artists. Neither Peso Pluma nor Kenia Os has shared any additional details beyond their joint statement.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "That's all for now. We wish both artists all the best. Thanks for tuning in to this update, and we'll be back with more music news soon."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
